{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABakTSKQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhEK4zk", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 75, "title": "Implement timed CD R–W subcode decoding and host pack transfers", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At main `3b2f8038ec8769b446274f8166f7e2d9917695ac`, CD initialization retains the R–W decode-enable bit, but `CdBlock::execute` returns WAIT unconditionally for command `0x2001` (`src/cd.rs:1303–1307`). Media has no subchannel stream. Existing tests verify only the empty-stream WAIT case (`tests/cd.rs:843–845`). Software cannot retrieve any R–W pack, irrespective of initialization, playback or elapsed hardware time.

This is a missing standard CD-block function under #17. Implementing it adds a real streaming path with independently testable data, timing, buffer and interrupt behavior.

## Expected outcome

Original subcode-bearing audio media must produce decoded packs through ordinary CD commands and DATATRNS accesses. Implement scheduled acquisition, integrity processing, bounded buffering, host transfers and lifecycle behavior. Guest instructions must configure and consume the hardware.

Use these primary references, reconciling revisions before implementation:

- [Sega CD Communication Interface §4.3](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/ssddv25/segahtml/prgg/sysg/cdif/hon/p04_10.htm): acquisition timing, decoding during CD-DA PLAY, startup, pause/seek retention, clearing on decode start, overflow and transfer completion. The later manual specifies a **24-pack ring**; [ST-162-062094 §4.3, printed pp.39–40](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-162-062094.pdf) previously described 23 packs. Preserve the distinction between physical capacity and the later text's 23-pack overwrite/recovery condition.
- [Later §7.2.4, Subcode Information](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/ssddv25/segahtml/prgg/sysg/cdif/hon/p07_11.htm): each acquired pack contains 24 bytes, transferred as 12 words, with R–W symbols in the documented bit positions.
- [§8.2.3, function 3.2](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/ssddv25/segahtml/prgg/sysg/cdif/hon/p08_13.htm): returned pack/overrun error flags and empty-buffer WAIT.
- [§8.2.1, CDC_CdInit](https://github.com/luckyseoul/saturn-docs/blob/main/files/ssddv25/segahtml/prgg/sysg/cdif/hon/p08_11.htm), §3.4 and §5.5: decode control, transfer termination and initialization domains.
- [IEC 60908, §§17.6 and 19.1–19.9, figures19–24](https://decode-orc.github.io/analogue-video-specifications/efm/IEC-60908-1999/IEC-60908-1999/): R–W pack organization, GF(2^6) P/Q parity and interleaving. Verify equations against the reproduced figures before deriving codec vectors. These are subcode parity codes, separate from channel-P/channel-Q reporting and CD-ROM sector ECC.

Document the media representation's position relative to disc deinterleaving. Implement each transformation exactly once. Add one bounded caller-supplied subchannel representation through native Media and production Wasm/local-file loading, with explicit FAD mapping, symbol order and malformed-input checks. Keep existing ISO/BIN/CUE behavior compatible. No filesystem discovery or network loading is needed.

Use the existing reference-clock scheduler for acquisition and decoder deadlines. Reconcile startup/pre-roll and figure4.5 before selecting exact publication phases; distinguish documented timing from deterministic conventions where the manuals leave phase unspecified. Buffer production must continue independently of host polling and audio muting/draining.

The scope is the built-in R–W decoder and host interface. A CD+G renderer, MPEG accessory, CD-TEXT application, general media-format expansion and unrelated raster changes are outside this task. Evidence-backed corrections to this AI-authored contract may be documented with exact primary references and rationale during implementation; they require no human confirmation.

## Context and reproduction

Inspect `src/cd.rs` initialization, playback, `advance`, FIFO and transfer handling; `src/media.rs`; `src/wasm.rs`; `tests/cd.rs`; `tests/cd_drive.rs`; and the CD/browser fixture infrastructure. The conformance matrix explicitly retains R–W decoding as missing at `docs/hardware-conformance.md:1268`.

The unconditional return establishes the missing path without rerunning a complete acceptance suite. After adding original subchannel media, a guest enabling decoding, playing its audio track and requesting a populated pack must fail against inherited main by remaining in WAIT.

Current main matches the inspected revision. No open task Issues were returned during planning. Main's native and Wasm checks passed; both browser shards were still running when observed. `docs/validation-issue-73.md` records the previous local regression results; those results do not establish this feature or umbrella completion.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record a primary-derived contract for pack layout, parity/deinterleaving boundary, 24-pack ring versus overwrite threshold, startup, scheduled publication, error flags and lifecycle. Reconcile later Sega corrections explicitly; derive expectations independently of production helpers.
- [ ] Add bounded subchannel media ingestion usable by native and production Wasm execution. Test truncation, size/count overflow, FAD/track mapping, missing or ambiguous companion data and failure atomicity. Existing local-file privacy guarantees remain intact.
- [ ] Implement real R–W integrity processing. Independent literal/codeword vectors cover clean packs, correctable symbol errors and demonstrably uncorrectable patterns, including header and payload corruption. Expectations must not rely solely on an encoder/decoder round trip sharing implementation logic.
- [ ] Implement clocked acquisition and buffering with before/at/after-deadline tests. Cover enable/no-change/disable, startup, audio/data track transitions, pause, seek, scan, repeat, overflow, wrap and documented recovery. Compare fixed-horizon traces across advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000 and passive inspection.
- [ ] Implement successful `0x2001` responses, exact 12-word payloads, error flags, empty WAIT, partial/full/excess transfers, DataEnd and competition with existing DATATRNS users. Test overwrite while a transfer is outstanding according to the documented contract. Preserve response protection and independently acknowledgeable HIRQ/SCU behavior; no duplicate FIFO consumption during replay.
- [ ] Test CD software reset, CDON/OFF, tray/media replacement and Machine reset at queued, decoding and partially transferred boundaries. Assert retained versus canceled state and absence of stale pack, transfer or interrupt publication.
- [ ] Supply reproducible, original MIT-licensed guest source and subcode-bearing mixed media. The SH-2 guest enables decoding, plays CD-DA, handles actual SCDQ/A-bus interrupts, retrieves packs using CPU reads and a supported SCU DMA transfer, and computes sequence/checksum/error records. Native Machine tests compare independently authored records and exact transferred words over repeated cold boots.
- [ ] Execute identical guest/media through rebuilt production Wasm under `/saturn-rust/`. Include changed pack payload, omitted decode-enable, corrected-error and uncorrectable-error controls. Guest records must change appropriately; inherited main must fail the nonempty-pack oracle. Confirm subchannel processing preserves the independently expected CD-DA stereo stream and existing WebAudio assertions.
- [ ] Preserve existing tests and all three demonstrations, including empty R–W WAIT, Q/status reporting, selectors, directories, transfers, CD-DA/PRE, reset, input, backup and privacy coverage. Register fixture reproduction and browser execution in the required inventories without skips or weaker publication gates.
- [ ] Update architecture, conformance and validation records with exact references, hashes, executed results and remaining deviations. Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native/Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, `sh scripts/check-fixtures.sh`, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, applicable CI-runner checks and the complete `npm run test:browser` suite.

This is partial progress toward #17. All remaining CPU/peripheral, bus/cache/reset/arbitration, SCU/DSP, video/audio/CD timing, media/HLE/SMPC and integrated acceptance requirements remain mandatory. Preserve the umbrella's unmet criteria and use plain references. Genuine BIOS operation and broad commercial-game compatibility remain unverified.

## Optional validation

Additional independently authored burst-error and track-boundary vectors. No proprietary firmware, commercial media, physical console, human testing/approval or live Pages inspection is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
